Visually confirmed legible on a white tile (slate-blue wordmark and blue/white crest). Wide aspect ratio; a square crop of the crest may suit small tiles.

Official institutional photograph of the SRCE main building published on the college's own homepage (src.org.in). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Wikimedia Commons searched 2026-10-22: no SRCE campus image exists. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 338,686 bytes, 1066x800 px (landscape, below the preferred 1000px+ ideal but acceptable).
